about: The shifts of the paper model, model B + tilts without alpha_2 (notes/higher_order_bias: the b2 and bs2 offsets and the counterterm alpha_0 per group, each with a straight line in redshift, flat priors on the tilts, SN0 and SN2 per group; alpha_2 = 0 in every bin) with the seven sigma_v prior widths 6 times those of the exploration fits, on the pessimistic linear-bias prior, DESI C_gg alone, against the scale cut k_max [h/Mpc; the z = 0 value of a per-bin cut at k_max/D(zbar_i), D the growth factor, by the UV-fraction criterion, alpha = 0.05, within the shipped mask]; null where a cut leaves no fit. Written by EXAMPLE_EVALUATE_FISHER_MODEL_B.ipynb. Truths, each the same in every bin (the drift: linear across each group). Inside the model's prior (in_prior_families, reported, never held to shift_threshold): SN2 = +-5 units of f_sat sigma_sat^2/nbar and the b2 and bs2 offsets at +-1 sigma of model B's widths (+-(2, 1), to first order). Tested (tested_families, held to shift_threshold): alpha_2 = +-12.5 h^-2 Mpc^2 and alpha_2 at one model B prior width (+-0.5/k_max^2; the two coincide at 0.2), terms the model lacks, and the calibration drift (the offsets linear in redshift across each group with zero mean, changing by calibration_drift; absorbed by the tilts). shift: per cut and truth, (w0, wa) in units of the fit's ellipse, Omega_m and A_s in their own sigma, by Fisher linear response; largest, largest_in_prior, largest_tested: the largest over every truth, over the truths inside the prior and over the tested ones, per score; break: the largest k_max with every tested shift below shift_threshold there and at every smaller fitted cut (null: the smallest fitted cut fails), and every failing cut.

truths.offsets: one sigma of the model B widths
